relationships.subject: optogenetic nociceptor stimulation
relationships.evidence_quote: compared with the contralateral hindpaw, significant mechanical hypersensitivity was observed in the ipsilateral hindpaw of NaV1.x–ChR2 mice

relationships.subject: optogenetic nociceptor stimulation
relationships.evidence_quote: In the spinal cord dorsal horn of NaV1.x–ChR2, compared to the contralateral side, c-Fos expression was increased in the ipsilateral side.

relationships.subject: DS-1971a
relationships.evidence_quote: DS-1971a at both 10 mg/kg and 100 mg/kg almost completely suppressed long-term optogenetic stimulation-induced neuropathic pain in the NaV1.7-ChR2, NaV1.8-ChR2 and NaV1.9-ChR2 mice

key_findings: Prolonged blue-light stimulation of NaV1.7/1.8/1.9-ChR2 mice produced reversible neuropathic pain lasting at least 24 h with increased dorsal horn c-Fos.
The selective NaV1.7 inhibitor DS-1971a suppressed this pain in all three light-responsive pain mouse lines.
